notablePrerequisites: You control at least X Goblins.
easyPrerequisites:
Krenko, Mob Boss does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Krenko.
description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating at least one 1/1 Goblin creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing a Goblin token, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Krenko.
Repeat.
